correctness.rationale: For t≥3 complex tensor factors of dimensions a_i≥2 and any positive bounds r_i, the diagonal one-parameter subgroup with coordinate weights Σ_j j_i B^(i−1), B=max a_i, is injective on basis tensor coordinates by base-B uniqueness. Its ambient projective fixed locus consists of exactly N=∏a_i pure-coordinate rank-one tensors, all lying in every Sub_r, so Sub_r has exactly N fixed points. Standard χ_c(C*)=0/Rosenlicht-stratification torus localization gives χ_top(Sub_r)=χ_c(Sub_r)=N. Since Sub_r is a finite disjoint union of locally closed exact mode-rank E_s over s≤r, induction/Möbius inversion on the finite product rank poset gives χ_c(E_(1,...,1))=N and χ_c(E_s)=0 for every other realizable rank. Independent mixed-radix enumeration in dimensions (2,2,2), (2,3,4), (3,3,3,2) checked injectivity; finite checks are only regression evidence, not topological proof.
